body_markdown:
Shopping for the trendsetter on your list means everything is an extension of their personal style. They are intentional about the clothes they wear, the brands they choose and the tech they use. In fact,


[Dwell](https://www.dwell.com/article/early-aughts-y2k-tech-decor-apple-g3-colorful-computer-b3093bd5-a348bae8-28ffed5a-1593189a) found that people are on the hunt for the Y2K candy-colored desktops and hamburger phones (regardless of whether they work) to round out their aesthetic homes.


The desk is a key player in this desire for devices that fit their style. Technology palettes have expanded beyond neutral offerings to include soft pastels and intentional color pairings. And customization for devices is non-negotiable whether it’s layout, lighting or sound profile.


If you want to wrap up something that shows you care and really know them, here are four desk builds a trendsetter would gladly welcome.


#### **1. The Sound Studio**


Sound is quickly rising as an important element for desk aesthetics beyond just visual appeal. And when it comes to typing, a creamy keyboard lets them bring the trendy ASMR-like experience right to their fingertips.


This build is centered around the


[Alto Keys K98M](https://www.logitech.com/shop/p/alto-keys-k98m) mechanical keyboard. Its translucent top case reveals the inner structure that creates the creamy sound profile. Round out the sensory audio experience by setting out frosted glass organizers to store pens and pour daily coffee or cocoa into an insulated glass mug.


####


#### **2. The After-Hours Shift**


You’ve seen the trendsetters whose hobbies bleed into their workspace. A collection of blindbox figures line their shelves and framed photos hang on their walls as they work on client decks and count the hours until they can switch from work to game mode.


This build bridges their interests and space with the


[Logitech G316 X 98](https://www.logitechg.com/shop/p/g316-x-98-gaming-keyboard) , a sleek, compact mechanical keyboard with a customizable RGB interactive light bar. Make it personal with


[G-KEYCAPS](https://www.logitechg.com/shop/p/g-keycaps-pbt-keycaps) such as the Cloud or Forest Set that bring a piece of their game to their hardware. Pair it with the comfy, coordinated palm rest for all-day support as they play and work.


#### **3. The Color-Coordinated Collection**


Color is a tried and true way to bring personality to the desk, and the introduction of new colorful laptops this year, like MacBook Neo, makes it easier to bring to the desk. But color doesn’t have to stop at your device. You can match your accessories to your laptop and personal style with the


[POP Icon Combo](https://www.logitech.com/shop/p/pop-icon-combo) .


The combo is made for color-coordinated workspaces with five bold colors. Or you can mix and match colorways by opting for the POP Icon Keys and POP Mouse instead to further customize your space. And don’t forget to complete the build by setting a soft, colorful base with the


[Logitech Desk Mat](https://www.logitech.com/shop/p/desk-mat-studio-series) .


#### **4. The Crimson Statement**


Saturated colors turn an ordinary desk into an intentional listening lounge. For someone who values rich sound, a clear mic and aesthetics when joining the squad for a raid, the


[Logitech G ASTRO A50 X](https://www.logitechg.com/en-us/shop/p/a50-x-astro-wireless-headset.939-002280) in Mars Red delivers clarity, detail and spatial and timing accuracy in a fiery color. For multiplayer games, this means your team hears you clearly and you can hear the other team try to sneak up behind you.


This build makes it easy to switch between devices and platforms with PLAYSYNC, connecting to Xbox, PlayStation and PC/Mac for instant access. And when they switch from desktop to console, look for a red controller they can use to match their headset.


Gifting is easy once you treat someone’s desk like an intentional space. Find the aesthetic that fits their taste, pack the box and let them take it from there.
